def draw_block(image, center, scale, reflected=False):
    aa=a*scale; bb=b*scale; height=31.5*scale
    # Far-left, far-right, near-right, near-left in pixel coordinates.
    feet=[center-aa/2-bb/2,center+aa/2-bb/2,center+aa/2+bb/2,center-aa/2+bb/2]
    top=[p-np.array([0,height]) for p in feet]
    # Diffuse contact and directional cast shadow hug the tabletop.
    cast=[feet[3]+[-5,2],feet[2]+[3,2],feet[1]+[8,5],feet[2]+[13,8],feet[3]+[1,7]]
    shadow(image,cast,2.2*scale,48 if reflected else 67)

    quad(image,face,[top[3],top[2],feet[2],feet[3]],.95 if reflected else 1.,tint)
    quad(image,side,[top[2],top[1],feet[1],feet[2]],.93 if reflected else .95,tint)
    quad(image,tex,[top[0],top[1],top[2],top[3]],.97 if reflected else 1.,tint)

    line(image,[top[2],top[1]],(188,144,93),.34*scale)

    line(image,[top[2]+[.13,.5],feet[2]+[.13,-.4]],(169,118,66),.43*scale)
    line(image,[top[3]+[.35,.7],feet[3]+[.35,-.5]],(201,153,97),.4*scale)
    line(image,[feet[3],feet[2],feet[1]],(130,90,48),.34*scale)
